question: By whose grace has the determination of the Kaula teaching become known?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Knowledge arose by that lord's grace
What is known is the determination of Kaula
inference: The speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching through the grace of the lord of Kaulas.
plain_english: O lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
